name: Generic Static List Row (Server-Templated)
description: The server-side layout generator's own generic row templates for dynamic/ad-hoc list layouts, keyed as ##LISTLAYOUT1COLS## and ##LISTLAYOUT2COLS## in the layout-loading store. These use the engine's OWN runtime placeholder tokens ($$FIELDCAPTION$$, $$FIELDVALUE$$, $$style$$) — a different, live substitution syntax from this library's own {{PARAM}} documentation placeholders. Do not confuse the two, and do not strip the $$...$$ tokens when reusing these templates verbatim.

oneColumn.description: Single value cell, no caption — used where the row's label is implicit (e.g. a plain list of descriptions).

twoColumnCaptionValue.description: Caption/value pair — used for key-details display panels (e.g. a details/summary view of a record).

usageNote: Fetched at runtime through PWA.LoadLayout by key (e.g. "##LISTLAYOUT2COLS##"), not authored inline in a page file — confirms these are generic, engine-provided building blocks rather than per-doctype content. See molecule.stored-action-formula and page/ notes on the keyed layout store.
